player_prompt.intro:
Tirid taɛebbut n Slitherlink ɣef {R}x{C} grid!
Aẓreg taɛebbut tameɣtut i yal tikli s yimiḍanen igdanen.
Beddel igdanen s:
  [h r c] - beddel aɣawas aɣezzafan afellay n tikeṛṛust ɣef uɣiwel r, tawla c
  [v r c] - beddel aɣawas abedday azelmaṭ n tikeṛṛust ɣef uɣiwel r, tawla c
Inumiren ssekcem-d ugar n yigdanen ilaqen, '.' anamek ulac ccekk.
Yes ɣarek alamma {max_turns} imussenen i tsebbi n tɛebbut.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Taqsi n uṭṭunḍaṭ ur igenni. Sken [h row col] neɣ [v row col].

outcome.win: Teffẓeḍ yiwet n tceqquft! Tamsirt tefra !
outcome.turn_limit: Yewweḍ-d uswir n umussu. Ur yekfi ara uẓemḍan.
